mapping_note: RL-422 records that the pinned Lab candidate is incorrectly labeled §10.57.6 and bound to evokeCallback. The candidate's source text belongs to §10.58 Evoke Multiple Callbacks; this local contract preserves the candidate ID while mapping only the tested public API behavior to §10.58.
notes: This contract records a bounded C++ public-API timing witness. Three receive-order interactions are sent during a 200 ms Evoke Multiple Callbacks minimum interval; the scenario checks that all callbacks are delivered before return and that elapsed time is not shorter than the requested minimum beyond a 20 ms scheduler tolerance. It runs only under HLA_EVOKED because the tested API behavior is the evoked callback servicing interval. It does not establish maximum-duration behavior, HLA_IMMEDIATE behavior, Java parity, independent-provider interoperability, or RTI conformance.
